tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a durable memory (a fact, preference, decision, or note) so it persists across sessions. Call this whenever the user tells you something worth remembering long-term.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search your stored memories for anything relevant to a query. Call this at the start of a task, or whenever you might have prior context about the user, project, or topic.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recently stored/updated memories in this space.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a memory by its id (from a previous recall/list result).
